ServerFeatureInteropTests.TransferSubscr.reason: the asyncua 2.0.1 server accepts TransferSubscriptions (Good) but does not implement Server.GetMonitoredItems (i=11492 has no method callback; Call returns BadNothingToDo from server/address_space.py MethodService._call), which the 2.0 client calls to adopt the monitored items of a transferred subscription (Subscription.TransferWithAcknowledgementsAsync), so TransferSubscriptionsAsync returns false
ServerFeatureInteropTests.TransferSubscr.issue: upstream issue to be filed at https://github.com/FreeOpcUa/opcua-asyncio/issues

ServerFeatureInteropTests.IndexRangeWrit.reason: the asyncua 2.0.1 server ignores the IndexRange of Read and Write (server/address_space.py AttributeService.read/write never look at ReadValueId/WriteValue.IndexRange): writing [20, 30] with IndexRange 2:3 replaces the whole array and reading 1:4 returns [20, 30]
ServerFeatureInteropTests.IndexRangeWrit.issue: upstream issue to be filed at https://github.com/FreeOpcUa/opcua-asyncio/issues

ServerFeatureInteropTests.SessionReconne.reason: the asyncua 2.0.1 server closes an activated session without subscriptions as soon as its TCP connection is lost (server/uaprocessor.py close() / _should_close_session_on_transport_loss) instead of keeping it until the session timeout (OPC 10000-4 5.6.1, 6.7), so ActivateSession on the new secure channel fails with BadSessionIdInvalid; the asyncua client reproduces it (its reconnect of a session without subscriptions falls back to a new session)
ServerFeatureInteropTests.SessionReconne.issue: upstream issue to be filed at https://github.com/FreeOpcUa/opcua-asyncio/issues
